examples.title: Portrait and presence
examples.description: Load the sample photo directly from Arc and keep name as its fallback. The wrapper is the accessible image.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: soft, outline and filled keep the identity display passive.

examples.title: All sizes
examples.description: The v1 footprints remain 24, 32, 40, 48 and 64px for xs, sm, md, lg and xl.

examples.title: All presence states
examples.description: aria-label preserves the identity; presence is supplied separately through aria-description. The dot is decorative, and omitting status keeps a plain avatar.

examples.title: Group and overflow
examples.description: max controls the visible people; the overflow includes hidden names in its description. A separate button expands the local group.

examples.title: Photo replacement and fallback
examples.description: Each URL starts a fresh loading attempt. A missing image falls back to initials; restoring the photo retries it.

examples.title: Explicit initials and custom content
examples.description: Explicit initials override generated letters. Custom children remain the fallback while an image is loading or fails.
